name: Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {R}.
Channel — {3}{R}, Discard this card: Create two 1/1 colorless Spirit creature tokens. They gain haste until end of turn. This ability costs {1} less to activate for each legendary creature you control.
blocked_sentences: Create two 1/1 colorless Spirit creature tokens.

needs.what: a token definition for a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token -- id `spirit_1_1_c`, name "Spirit Token", types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Spirit"], colors [], power 1, toughness 1, is_token true -- added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json so `create_token` can name it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` takes only a `token` id string naming a card already in the pool, and `loader.validate_token_references` raises `references unknown card` at load time for any id not present and marked `is_token`, so the card cannot ship ahead of the definition. The pool has 44 tokens and no Spirit at all; the only 1/1 colorless bodies are `hero_1_1_c` and `gnome_1_1_c`, whose subtypes are wrong, and substituting one would hand the player a creature type the card does not print -- which matters, because Spirit is a tribe cards care about. A token definition is data a card worker may not write, and this is the same block already recorded for Swan Song's Bird.
needs.blocks_only: the token clause; everything else on the card is expressible today

notes: The rest of the channel line needs nothing new, and the cost-reduction clause it shares with the other four Kamigawa channel legends now works: `cost: {"mana": "{3}{R}", "discard_self": true, "mana_reduction": {"count": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "supertypes": ["Legendary"]}}}` on an `active_zones: ["hand"]` activated ability, exactly as shipped on Boseiju, Otawara, Takenuma and Eiganjo. "They gain haste until end of turn" is `create_token` with `as: "them"` and a `grant_keyword` over `{"binding": "them"}` -- the Flamerush Rider idiom -- so this card is one token definition away from shipping.
